remarks: Spacious 1 bedroom, 1.5 bath apartment rental in sought after high-rise doorman building. Enjoy quiet and comfortable living with sweeping western exposure and spectacular sunset views from the covered, screened-in balcony. The well appointed, renovated kitchen opens to the dining and living areas creating seamless flow between the spaces for easy entertaining or daily enjoyment. The spacious, light-filled primary retreat has two large closets and recently upgraded zoned heat pumps will keep you comfortable no matter the season. Conveniently located near downtown Stamford shops, dining, and entertainment with easy access to Metro North, I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. 1 covered, on-site parking space is included as well as a basement storage locker.
